meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth, including Tip: lines in the TUI. Use when the user asks about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips they can see.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 解释界面里每条提示，让你明白它的作用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果看到提示总想弄懂它在说什么功能。
copy.tagline_en: Understand every tip and feature with clear explanations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you see a tip and want to know what it means and what it does.

howto.what: 装上后，用户询问 senpi 的提示(Tip)时，Claude 会先核对实时提示列表和该用户的可见设置，再阅读对应代码验证机制，最后用用户的语言给出带文件路径的深度解释，而非复述提示原文。
howto.when: 当用户问起某条 Tip 的含义、被提示的功能怎么运作、或自己能看到哪些 Tip 时触发。

say.text: 刚才那条 Tip: 是什么意思？
say.note: 会查实时提示列表并联系代码给出深度解释。
会读取你的设定，列出你实际会遇到的提示及原因。

say.text: 解释一下 Fable 5 拒绝后出现的提示。
say.note: 会讲解后备架构流程的具体机制。

howto.what_en: When installed, if the user asks about a senpi tip, Claude first checks the live tip list and what this specific user is allowed to see, reads the actual feature code to verify, then replies in the user's language with a file-cited, in-depth explanation instead of restating the tip text.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips they can see.

say_en.text: What does that Tip: line mean?
say_en.note: It checks the live tip list and explains the actual mechanism from the code.
It reads your settings and lists the tips you can actually meet, with reasons.

say_en.text: Explain the tip shown after a Fable 5 refusal.
say_en.note: It walks through the fallback-architect mechanism, citing concrete files.
